news.title: shunkai Launches New Hybrid ANC Headset Series
news.title_zh: shunkai 发布全新混合降噪耳机系列
news.descr: Our flagship active noise cancelling headset series now ships with hybrid ANC and multipoint pairing.
news.descr_zh: 旗舰主动降噪耳机系列现已升级为混合式 ANC 降噪并支持多点连接。
news.content:
Product Launch

We are excited to announce the new ASK-1000 ANC series, offering hybrid noise cancelling up to 35dB.

  1. Hybrid ANC architecture
  2. Multipoint Bluetooth 5.3
  3. 40 hour battery life
Designed for travelers who demand silence and clarity.
FeatureBenefit
ANC35dB reduction
Battery40h playtime
news.content_zh:
产品发布

我们很高兴推出全新的 ASK-1000 ANC 系列，混合式降噪深度可达 35dB。

  1. 混合式 ANC 架构
  2. 蓝牙 5.3 多点连接
  3. 40 小时续航
为追求静谧与清晰的出行者而设计。
特性优势
ANC降噪深度 35dB
电池40 小时播放

news.title: shunkai Expands Smart Manufacturing in Dongguan
news.title_zh: shunkai 扩建东莞智能制造基地
news.descr: New automated production lines improve quality consistency across the Dongguan campus.
news.descr_zh: 新增自动化产线，全面提升东莞园区的品质一致性。
news.content:
Our Dongguan factory has deployed new automated assembly lines, boosting yield rate to 99.2%.

  • Automated SMT lines
  • Inline acoustic testing
  • Batch traceability
news.content_zh:
我们的东莞工厂已投入使用新的自动化组装线，良率提升至 99.2%。

  • 自动化 SMT 产线
  • 在线声学测试
  • 批次可追溯

news.title: shunkai Awarded 'Contract-Abiding Enterprise'
news.title_zh: shunkai 荣获“守合同重信用企业”称号
news.descr: Guangdong Province recognizes shunkai for outstanding creditworthiness and reliability.
news.descr_zh: 广东省认可 shunkai 在信用与可靠性方面的突出表现。
news.content:
A national high-tech enterprise awarded the “contract abiding and trustworthy” title.

This honor reflects our long-term commitment to quality and trust in the global wireless audio market.
news.content_zh:
国家高新技术企业，荣获“守合同重信用”称号。

这项荣誉体现了我们在全球无线音频市场对品质与信誉的长期坚守。

news.title: New Industrial Communication Headset for Noisy Sites
news.title_zh: 全新工业通讯耳机，专为高噪声场景打造
news.descr: The ASK-250 delivers clear two-way radio communication in extreme industrial noise.
news.descr_zh: ASK-250 在极端工业噪声环境下依然保持清晰的双向对讲。
news.content:
The ASK-250 features a noise-immune microphone and IP54 protection, ideal for factories, warehouses and construction.

setup() {
  enableNoiseImmunity()
  setProtection("IP54")
}
news.content_zh:
ASK-250 配备抗噪麦克风与 IP54 防护，适用于工厂、仓库与建筑工地。

setup() {
  enableNoiseImmunity()
  setProtection("IP54")
}
